subject: NAMES are written TWICE in MPlus input file created using mplusObject() and mplusModeler()

messages.subject: NAMES are written TWICE in MPlus input file created using mplusObject() and mplusModeler()
parts:
Dear all,

I am a MplusAutomation rookie. So, maybe one of you has a simple solution for the following problem.

The problem is that the names are written twice in the MPlus Input File that I created using mplusObject() and mplusModeler().

Here is the generated MPlus Input file:

Any ideas?
Btw, for any reason, it also created the file name twice in the MPlus input file.

cheers,
Michael

messages.author: 5dadf4dbf792b603
messages.subject: Re: NAMES are written TWICE in MPlus input file created using mplusObject() and mplusModeler()
parts:
I now found a way to produce the desired input file which contains the names (and file name) only once.
That is, I gave the total list of variables for the MPlus "NAMES =" command into the usevariable argument and I gave the variables for the MPlus usevars command into the VARIABLE argument (see below).
Plus, I removed the DATA argument and used the dataout argument intstead.
see:
Model.MAJ <- mplusObject(
VARIABLE="usevar = arts_maj AELL1 AELL2 AELL3 AELL4 AELL5 AELL6

BELL1 BELL2 BELL3 BELL4 BELL5 BELL6
CELL1 CELL2 CELL3 CELL4 CELL5 CELL6
DELL1 DELL2 DELL3 DELL4 DELL5 DELL6;"

,
usevariables = c("arts_maj", "ANAR06", "ANAR09", "ANAR10", "ANAR11", "ANAR12", "ANAR16", "BNAR06", "BNAR09", "BNAR10", "BNAR11", "BNAR12", "BNAR16",
           "CNAR6", "CNAR9", "CNAR10", "CNAR11", "CNAR12", "CNAR16", "DNAR6", "DNAR9", "DNAR10", "DNAR11", "DNAR12", "DNAR16",

ANALYSIS="ESTIMATOR = MLR; PROCESSORS=4;",
  MODEL="ell1 BY AELL1 AELL2 AELL3 AELL4 AELL5 AELL6;
ell2 BY BELL1 BELL2 BELL3 BELL4 BELL5 BELL6;
ell3 BY CELL1 CELL2 CELL3 CELL4 CELL5 CELL6;
ell4 BY DELL1 DELL2 DELL3 DELL4 DELL5 DELL6;
AELL1 with BELL1 CELL1 DELL1;
BELL1 with CELL1 DELL1; CELL1 with DELL1;
AELL2 with BELL2 CELL2 DELL2;
BELL2 with CELL2 DELL2; CELL2 with DELL2;
AELL3 with BELL3 CELL3 DELL3; BELL3 with CELL3 DELL3;
CELL3 with DELL3; AELL4 with BELL4 CELL4 DELL4;
BELL4 with CELL4 DELL4; CELL4 with DELL4;
AELL5 with BELL5 CELL5 DELL5; BELL5 with CELL5 DELL5;
CELL5 with DELL5; AELL6 with BELL6 CELL6 DELL6;
BELL6 with CELL6 DELL6; CELL6 with DELL6;
[AELL1@0 BELL1@0 CELL1@0 DELL1@0 ] (im1);
[AELL2 BELL2 CELL2 DELL2] (im2);
[AELL3 BELL3 CELL3 DELL3] (im3);
[AELL4 BELL4 CELL4 DELL4] (im4);
[AELL5 BELL5 CELL5 DELL5] (im5);
[AELL6 BELL6 CELL5 DELL6] (im6);
i s | ell1@0 ell2@1 ell3@2 ell4@3;
[i s];
s on arts_maj;",rdata=data,autov=T)

mplusModeler(Model.MAJ,dataout="matchARTS.out", modelout="matchARTS.inp", check=T)

cheers,
Michael

Dear Michael,

Your latter way is correct.  Actually, if you just want to use all variables from the dataset, I often use code like:

mplusObject(
  VARIABLE="usevar = arts_maj AELL1 AELL2;", 
  usevariables = colnames(data),
  rdata = data)

If you explicitly specify to mplus the "USEVARIABLES", there is no real problem including every variable from your dataset, so it saves a bit of typing.

Best wishes,

Josh
